name: Ranger Sanctified Hunter
body:
Many religions have priests and holy warriors filling their ranks, but some also employ sanctified hunters to track down their enemies or scout the borderlands of their domains.

Skills: A sanctified hunter adds Knowledge (religion) to their class skills.

Blessed Sight (Ex)

Beginning with 1st level, the sanctified hunter gains a bonus equal to 1/2 their class level to saving throws against illusions.

This ability replaces wild empathy.

Sanctified Foe (Su)

At 1st level, you gain your favored enemies bonuses against creatures whose alignment is at least 2 steps away from your deity’s or religion’s alignment. Additionally, if your religion has an anathema against a creature type, like undead, or against a specific creature, they may apply their bonus to them as well. The sanctified hunter does not gain additional favored enemies, though the bonus increases each time they would normally gain a new favored enemy.

This ability replaces favored enemy.

Detect Alignment (Sp)

The sanctified hunter can use detect chaos, detect evil, detect good, or detect law. They can only use one of these at any given time.

This ability replaces favored terrain.

Holy Magics

The sanctified hunter adds all paladin spells to their spell list in addition to ranger spells.

This ability modifies spellcasting.
